text: On my first day at work, I felt nervous. When I walked in, a man said, 'Hello! Welcome to our office.' He had a friendly smile. He wanted to introduce himself, so he told me his name and shook hands with me. I said, 'Nice to meet you.' We started a short conversation. He asked me questions about my old job, and I tried to answer clearly. Sometimes I could not understand him because he spoke very fast, so I said, 'Sorry, can you speak more slowly, please?' He smiled and spoke again in a soft voice. I listened carefully this time, and I understood everything. We talked for ten minutes. Before he left, he said, 'Thanks for your time. See you tomorrow!' I said, 'Goodbye, and thanks again for your help.' I felt happy because everyone was friendly. Good communication is important at work. When you meet new people, it helps to smile, listen well, and ask questions. A short conversation can help you make new friends quickly.
